method: Product space (Hidalgo, Klinger, Barabasi and Hausmann 2007), as in the Atlas of Economic Complexity: Balassa RCA on three-year export averages, proximity on countries exporting at least US$1 billion, density of each product a country does not yet export competitively.
left_out: Mining, fuel and precious-metal products (HS chapters 25, 26, 27, 71): geology, not discovery. Unused stamps and banknotes (4907), works of art (chapter 97) and waste or scrap headings: not something a firm discovers it can make.
complexity: Product complexity index from the 2022-24 product space (the Atlas method), standardized. A product is 'more complex' than a country's typical export when its index is above the average index of the products that country exports competitively.
kill_check: Top-20 overlap 2017-19 vs 2022-24 must beat the 95th percentile of 99 product-space shuffles (seed 20261101).
source: Growth Lab International Trade Data (HS92), doi:10.7910/DVN/T4CHWJ, via data/silver/hs4_exports.parquet
